notes.title: Patch 1.02 Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.02 is now live! It's mainly a bug-fixing patch and addresses the following issues:



Bug fixes with interact system

Bug fixes with navigation

Added tracker to display the total number of narrations and photos found in the level

Input hints were added to all levels that do not have an intro cinematic (Drydock)

Fixed total number of narrations and photos showing incorrect number when inside Morro Castle Interior

Updates button on main menu now points to the correct page

Fixed position of pause menu details when UI scale is low

Fixed weather widget not being scrollable on gamepad when UI scale is high

Controller interaction enhancements and bug fixes

Fixed typos and grammatical errors in descriptions of found photos

Bug fixes with shading issues

Bug fixes with teleporting

Bug fixes with collisions

We’re continuing to test and monitor feedback for this release. If you encounter any issues as a result of this update, please reach out and we will do our best to follow up as we are able to. Future updates will add new content to the experience which we cannot wait to share with you!

Happy exploring!

~The Turbine Room Studios Team

Screenshot by Discord user Lodkins.
